Original User Story: As a site member, I want to describe myself on my own page in a semi-structured way, so that others can learn about me.
Rewritten User Story:
User Story:
As a site member, I want to create a semi-structured personal description on my profile page so that other users can easily understand my background, interests, and skills.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Provide a template that includes at least 5 distinct sections (e.g., Biography, Interests, Skills, Achievements, and Contact Information) for users to fill out.
- Ensure that each section has a character limit of 250 characters to maintain conciseness and clarity.
- Allow users to preview their description before final submission to ensure accuracy and satisfaction.

Test Outline:
- Verify that the profile page includes the semi-structured template with the specified sections.
- Check that each section enforces the character limit of 250 characters during input.
- Confirm that users can view a preview of their description prior to saving it to their profile.

- Track the application review timeline to ensure feedback is delivered within the 10 business day window.
